description: This file defines a PHP trait 'ControllerTrait' that provides common controller functionalities such as request forwarding, retrieving the current request, and performing redirects within the OrangeHRM project.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Forwards the current request to another controller specified by the controller string, with optional attributes and query parameters.

methods.name: getCurrentRequest
methods.description: Retrieves the current HTTP request from the request stack.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Generates a redirect response to the specified path, considering the current request's scheme and host.
